title: Hummus Chicken Platter
shortDescription: Sliced spiced chicken over creamy hummus with veg and pita
subtitle: Sliced spiced chicken over creamy hummus with veg and pita
description: Spiced grilled or roasted chicken breast slices fan over a base of hummus with cucumber, tomato, olives, and warm pita for scooping.
equipment: Large serving platter or hotel pan

steps.title: Make hummus base
steps.instruction: Blend chickpeas, tahini, half the lemon juice, 4 garlic cloves, cumin, and 2 tbsp olive oil until silky smooth, adding ice water as needed.

steps.title: Season and cook chicken
steps.instruction: Rub chicken with paprika, minced garlic, salt, and 2 tbsp oil. Roast at 425°F 18–22 minutes until 165°F with lightly charred edges.

steps.title: Rest and slice chicken
steps.instruction: Rest chicken 5 minutes, then slice ¼-inch against the grain. Slices should be moist with no pink center and clean cut edges.

steps.title: Assemble platter
steps.instruction: Spread hummus in a large pan, drizzle olive oil and paprika. Arrange chicken over hummus with cucumber, tomatoes, and olives around edges.

steps.title: Warm pita and serve
steps.instruction: Warm pita 5 minutes wrapped in foil at 300°F until soft and pliable. Serve for scooping hummus and chicken together.

proTips: Ice water in hummus makes it fluffier—add 2 tbsp at a time while blending.
Sumac sprinkle at the line adds tartness without extra prep.
Grill chicken on flat-top if oven is occupied—same spice rub works.
leftovers: Chicken and hummus wrap with extra cucumber.
Hummus dip with raw veg for next-shift snack.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Interactive platter format feels special but scales easily. High protein from chicken with fiber from hummus and veg.
mealPrepNotes: Make hummus smooth in a food processor ahead. Slice chicken against the grain for tender bites. Station: Spread hummus in a large shallow hotel pan for maximum scoop surface. Station: Arrange chicken in overlapping rows so portions look generous at the line. Station: Keep pita wrapped in foil in low oven until service.
